items.title: General Electric (GE) Lands First GEnx Engine Order From Malaysia Aviation Group
items.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) unit GE Aerospace won a Malaysia Aviation Group order for GEnx engines to power new Boeing 787 Dreamliners. The selection marks Malaysia Aviation Group's first use of GEnx engines on its future 787 widebody fleet. Malaysia Aviation Group also renewed digital analytics agreements with GE Aerospace alongside the widebody engine decision.
